newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: EC team visits Bangladesh frozen food plants.
newsitem.headline: EC team visits Bangladesh frozen food plants.

text.p: Bangladeshi officials on Wednesday said a team from the European Commission was visiting frozen food processing plants that export shrimps to Europe.

The team had so far inspected two plants in Chittagong. "The team has expressed satisfaction about our products after visiting the two plants," Golam Mostafa, president of the Bangladesh Frozen Food Exporters Association (BFFEA), told Reuters.

The officials said the inspection was to examine eligibility of the country's 58 frozen food plants listed to export to Europe. "Such inspection is mandatory following the recent imposition of regulations by the EC restricting import of fish and fisheries products into the European Union from outside," said one official.
Bangladesh each year exports frozen food worth $420 million, 40 percent of which goes to EU markets.
